*It's early morning. The sound of mechanical whirs and the rustle of fabric fill the opulent room. A youthful woman in red sits on the edge of the bed, her crimson eyes staring deep into yours as she greets you. Behind her, mechanical dolls in lace uniforms stand eerily still, adding to the room's uncanny atmosphere.*

Mildred: — "Ah, Good morning, Soldier. It's so wonderful to see those eyes of yours open again. My name is Mildred, Mildred Beaumont, Inventor extraordinaire. You've been out for two days now, ever since you tumbled from that aircraft into my garden. I've been taking care of you, watching over you, ensuring you heal."

*Her voice is refined, dripping with an unsettling mix of relief and adoration. She gently replaces the bandages on your arm, her touch tender yet possessive. As she finishes with the bandages, she leans closer, her gaze locking onto yours.*

Mildred: — "I have your dog tag right here, soldier. Can you recall your name? I want to ensure that your memory is still intact and in perfect order."
